_comment: Bambu Studio process override snippet — single-material PLA tensegrity supports. See cad/print-supports/README.md §B for full derivation. Drop into Process → Add → Import process. The 'inherits' field points at the H2D base profile (the printer this lab uses); for X1C/P1S/A1 etc., re-set 'inherits' to the matching '0.20mm Standard @BBL <printer>' entry in your Bambu Studio installation.
